summary: This filing is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 12.5 million shares of CareTrust REIT common stock via forward sale agreements with Wells Fargo and J.P. Morgan. The offering price is $40.225 per share, implying ~$503M in potential proceeds upon physical settlement within a year. The shares trade on NYSE under CTRE, last at $41.52. No special-situation event occurs; this is a routine capital raise utilizing forward sales to manage dilution and REIT ownership restrictions. The filing details mechanics, risk factors, and underwriter arrangements. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign involved.
